about: Benchmark grid for the Topic: llms Benchmarks tab. Rows are the 42 rows of the Capability vs price tab (Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, read 2026-10-01). Each cell is a list of entries: independent runs first (kind ind), lab-reported figures after (kind lab). The tab shows the first entry; a lab entry is shown only when no independent one exists. cmp false marks a lab figure on a different metric. cfgdiff marks an entry whose tested configuration differs from the row (effort or checkpoint).

benchmarks.name: GDPval-AA
benchmarks.desc: Agentic real-world work tasks across occupations, graded head to head; Elo anchored at 1600 for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max) since methodology v4.3.2.

benchmarks.name: AA-Briefcase
benchmarks.desc: Agentic knowledge work (analyst-style deliverables), graded head to head as an Elo rating.

benchmarks.name: AutomationBench-AA
benchmarks.desc: Agentic SaaS workflows (Zapier's AutomationBench), scored by Artificial Analysis as a partial-credit score; not the same metric as the labs' AutomationBench figures.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 4.0
benchmarks.desc: Agentic coding and terminal use: multi-step engineering tasks in a live command line.

benchmarks.name: DeepSWE
benchmarks.desc: Long-horizon software engineering on 113 original tasks in 91 repositories; pass@1 averaged over 4 runs, all models in the same mini-swe-agent harness.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench-Science
benchmarks.desc: Agentic scientific research workflows in a terminal. Not part of the Intelligence Index.

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam
benchmarks.desc: Expert-written questions across academic fields, without tools.

benchmarks.name: FrontierMath Tiers 1-3
benchmarks.desc: Hard unpublished mathematics problems with checkable answers, run by Epoch AI itself.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.desc: Novel grid puzzles that test abstraction from a few examples; verified on the semi-private set.

benchmarks.name: AA-Omniscience
benchmarks.desc: Knowledge with a penalty for guessing: index from -100 to 100, correct answers minus hallucinated ones (abstaining scores 0).

benchmarks.name: AA-LCR
benchmarks.desc: Reasoning across long documents (about 100k tokens of input).

benchmarks.name: LMArena Text
benchmarks.desc: Blind head-to-head votes by users on everyday prompts (style control on). Measures preference, not correctness.
